facts.fact: 三个不习惯：被无视、魅惑失效、对她之血无休止的渴——三句排比层层失控。
facts.anchor: I’m not used to being ignored. I’m not used to my compulsion having no effect. And I’m sure as hell not used to this relentless craving for Edie’s blood.

facts.fact: 水过玻璃：他的意志一次次找缝都撞上密不透风的盾——此事实比阳光更令他不安，却不减饥饿。
facts.anchor: But Edie is an Aegis and my will slides off her like water on glass. I’ve tried, again and again, to find a crack, a sliver to slip through, only to come up against an impenetrable shield. That truth unsettles me more than sunlight ever could, but it does nothing to dull my hunger.

facts.fact: 底线宣誓：另一个选项说不出口——绝不取她性命，绝不重蹈过去的错误。
facts.anchor: The other option is unspeakable, and I will not end her life. I will not repeat past mistakes.

facts.fact: 限时剧本：成为恋人、给她此生未有的欢愉——等她点燃的火焰熄灭就结束风流，各自上路。
facts.anchor: We will become lovers. I will give her more pleasure than she has ever experienced in her life. I will teach her what her body is capable of, and once the flame she’s ignited within me sputters and dies, our brief affair will end.

facts.fact: 当街破规：喂食不许在 Avant Garde 之外——但要么喂这路人要么喂 Edie，他选了不复杂的那个。
facts.anchor: I’m fully aware I’ve just broken one of my own rules. Feeding is not allowed outside the protection of Avant Garde, but it was either feeding from this man or Edie. I chose the less complicated option.

facts.fact: 善后指令：忘掉一切——然后回家喝点甜的。灭口式体贴。
facts.anchor: You will forget everything. You will forget this interaction, but you will go home and drink something sweet.”

facts.fact: 送上门的时机：Logan 挖出二人底细——本就打算早晚处理，今夜正好尽泄怒火。
facts.anchor: but as they’ve graced us with their presence tonight, now is the perfect opportunity to unleash my wrath.

facts.fact: 罪名宣读：你想给我的女人下药——所以再说一遍你已经不是那种人了。
facts.anchor: “You attempted to drug my woman. So tell me again you’re not that man anymore.”

facts.fact: 名字死刑：真面目浮起、犬齿落下——这是你们最后一次听到自己的名字。
facts.anchor: “Because John, Mark,” I say, my voice cold as the true face of the monster within me rises to the surface, and my fangs descend. “This is the last time you’ll ever hear your names.”
